core_policy: primary non-singing production + manual/manually corrected/exhaustively human-verified relevant annotations or measurements
registry_note: Base registries are supplemented by dated increment CSVs under data/registry/increments/. Append-only policy-correction increments supersede earlier decisions when scope conflicts are found.
warehouse_policy: preserve all source variables before harmonization; public download is not assumed to grant redistribution rights
warehouse_count_note: Current row/table counters include the validated PAVOQUE core parse (5 canonical YAML files; 5,442 core utterance rows + 246,386 manually corrected segment rows), the 45-row Coretta lexical lookup table, the complete 3,253-row Coretta formants-ids.csv linkage table, and now the complete 172-row Coretta stimuli.csv context table. This pass materialized stimuli.csv source-faithfully from immutable upstream blob 32ac81d0d7a8df152645dd20f26cac522c313f1d and added all 11 original variables to a source-specific variable dictionary; no IPA was inferred from orthography or c1/vowel/c2 labels. Coretta lexical/linkage/stimulus rows are metadata/linkage observations and do not increase unique speech-token counts. The 1,892 PAVOQUE outtake utterance records are parsed and lineage-preserved but excluded from the core row counter. Full PAVOQUE observation tables were validated in workflow artifact 10027976609; durable in-repository generator/checksums/status are retained because CI contents permission is read-only. VoxAngeles decile trajectories are explicitly canonical and quartile trajectories overlapping alternates; pending large TSV materialization is not yet added to warehouse counts.
